text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALES - Algeria bought 150,000 tonnes of Canadian wheat for shipment in July and August, European exporters said. Pricing details were not immediately available but one exporter pegged the price at around $165 per tonne C+F basis.

- A private Moroccan firm on Thursday bought 30,000 tonnes of optional-origin soft wheat at $149.50 per tonne including freight, European traders said. The wheat is for delivery by July 25, they said.

WHEAT AND BARLEY SALE - Japan's Food Agency said on Thursday it had bought 60,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, 40,000 of Canadian wheat, 40,000 of Australian wheat, 20,000 of U.S. barley and 30,000 of Australian barley in its weekly tender. They are for August shipment.

CORN AND SOY SALE - A Japanese trading house won the bidding for a combined cargo of 55,000 tonnes of soybeans and corn in a tender by Malaysia's Soon Soon Oilmills Sdn Bhd, traders said. The shipment is for November arrival.

WHEAT TENDER - Pakistan is tendering on June 25 for 500,000 tonnes of optional origin white wheat, July 11-August 10 shipment, a spokesman at the country's U.S. embassy in Washington said. He said the wheat would be either from the United States, Australia or Canada.

- The CCC was tendering on June 19 for up to 40,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for export to Armenia. The wheat was slated for June 30-July 15 shipment. The tender was in combination with another for 1,500 to 2,000 tonnes of U.S. HRW under PL-480 program, Title One. Shipment on the second tender was June 30-July 15 with offers due on June 19.

WHEAT TENDERS cont'd - The CCC said it was seeking up to 42,000 tonnes of U.S. no.2 or better hard red winter wheat under its export program for Ethiopia. The shipment period was set July 15-July 30. Offers were due on June 26.

Guyana was tendering on Thursday for 2,300 tonnes of spring wheat, 1,000 tonnes of soft red winter and 3,000 tonnes of hard red winter under the PL-480 program, agents for the buyer said. Shipment was slated for July 4-26.
- The CCC was seeking up to 6,750 tonnes of Northern Spring/Dark Northern Spring wheat to Honduras. The shipment period was set for July 10-August 5. Offers were due June 24.

WHEAT TENDERS - The Cyprus Grain Commission on Wednesday invited tenders for the supply of 12,000 tonnes of soft bread making wheat, a statement from the commission said. Shipment period is scheduled between July 15 and 30, 1997. The tender closing date is Tuesday, June 24.

PALM OIL TENDER - Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries was seeking 25,000 tonnes of Malaysian and/or Indonesian palm stearin and palm oil for delivery in August. The deadline for bids was 0900 GMT on June 25. The oils were in the following lots: -- 10,000 tonnes of palm stearin and 15,000 tonnes of palm oil.
SOYMEAL TENDER - The Korea Feed Association (KFA) on Thursday passed on tenders to buy 30,000 tonnes of soymeal due to higher-than-expected prices, traders said.

MARKET TALK - Egypt is unlikely to tap world wheat markets soon as it enjoys comfortable supplies, the chairman of state procurement agency GASC said. "I am very relaxed. We are starting the new season with large stocks. We are in a very strong position to face the market," Ahmed Samir el Shakankiri told a reporter during a London meeting of the International Grains Council.
... Indonesia may import at leasst five million tonnes of wheat for its flour mills by the year 2000 with Australia capturing the bulk of the business, a top Indonesian miller saidon Thursday.
... The Australian Wheat Board was confident it would complete its one million tonne wheat shipment to India this year despite problems raised about weed seed cntent, an AWB spokesman said..
... Traders in Asia offered conflicting views on Thursday over talk that China bought 28,000 tonnes of U.S. soyoil, with some confirming a vessel was fixed and others noting the vessel was cancelled.
